Overview

The Frigidaire 24" built-in dishwasher delivers effective cleaning and enhanced drying so you spend less time at the sink. Triple spray arms target every dish, while the MaxDry option helps minimize towel drying. Designed to fit medium to large households, it operates quietly at just 54 dB.
  • Fits 14 place settings—great for medium to large households
  • Quiet 54 dB operation; similar to normal conversation in another room
